summary: Reproduced the DFlash count-collision fallback at the recorded base: a missing dflash_config.target_layer_ids resolved to [1, 16, 31, 46, 61] for a 64-layer target and five-layer draft, which has the same width but differs from the trained [5, 19, 33, 47, 61]. Removed the formula fallback and now require the checkpoint's explicit tap list, while preserving explicit-list range validation.

tests.command: /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-33bf3d22a401/venv/bin/python inline reproduction using parse_dflash_draft_config and resolve_target_layer_ids
tests.what_was_measured: Before the fix, the actual checkout returned [1, 16, 31, 46, 61] instead of [5, 19, 33, 47, 61], with equal list lengths; raw output: reports/j-33bf3d22a401/raw/reproduction-before.txt.
Six post-fix regression and boundary cases passed: missing-key collision rejection, verbatim explicit IDs, nonpositive target depths, and lower/upper out-of-range IDs.
All 16 DFlash unit tests passed; raw output: reports/j-33bf3d22a401/raw/test-dflash-logits.txt.
All five auxiliary hidden-state tests passed after updating the production call site; raw output: reports/j-33bf3d22a401/raw/test-spec-aux-hidden-state.txt.
Repository formatting, lint, syntax, registry, and policy hooks passed; raw output: reports/j-33bf3d22a401/raw/pre-commit.txt.

gpu_execution.evidence: The reproduced defect and fix are deterministic CPU-side config resolution. No DFlash checkpoint weights were provided, so a gfx950 smoke could not validate trained tap semantics or acceptance quality and was not used as substitute evidence.

remaining_limitations: No full DFlash/DFlash2 model was loaded because the affected checkpoint weights were unavailable.
Acceptance-rate recovery was not measured; the regression proves the unsafe guessed configuration is rejected before model execution.
No GPU execution was performed because it would not add issue-specific evidence without the affected weights.
Upstream PR https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/37476 was inspected and remained open during this investigation.
